scope: Independent original-detail review of rr-broiled-fish-v4, including focused reciprocal gaze check

entries.alt: The risen Jesus turns toward a disciple while holding a piece of fish, with another disciple watching beside him.
entries.caption: The risen Jesus eats before His disciples in Luke's account. This imagined indoor scene gives their astonished joy a personal focus, distinct from the shore breakfast in John 21.
findings: Christ's head now turns to the central disciple; His visible near eye narrows naturally with the smile and points right/down toward that disciple's upturned eyes. The former elevated look past the disciples is corrected.
Canonical facial identity remains recognizable in the stronger profile: characteristic brow, nose, beard and wavy hair are retained. Photographic expression and warm attention suit the reunion.
The exposed left palm's healed oval mark and visible wrist marks remain. Fish grip, open palm, disciple hands, food and table contacts remain coherent.
Secondary disciples remain visually distinct. This technical pass does not imply owner approval.
entries.gazeDirection: Right/down toward the central disciple's upturned eyes
